about: Manual comparison of each campus building with Esri World Imagery z19 (side-by-side sheets from qa/campus-tops.mjs + qa/campus_audit_imagery.py), 2026-10-30. A person's reading of the imagery, not a measurement. Tall buildings lean on the imagery (off-nadir), so roofs of buildings over ~25 m appear shifted north-east of their footprint. status: ok = model parts and roof agree with imagery; fixed = disagreed and was rebuilt in qa/rebuild; issue = disagrees, not fixed (reason given); uncertain = imagery cannot settle it.
